description:
## [1.3.0](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/apple-music-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.3.0)

**Suporte a Android TV, em cima das correções de UI da 1.2.0.**

- Manifest: adiciona o intent-filter `LEANBACK_LAUNCHER` e um banner na `MainActivity`, e declara `android.software.leanback` e `android.hardware.touchscreen` como `required=false`. O mesmo APK continua abrindo no DiLink.
- Foco D-pad no conteúdo: highlight de foco nos cards do Listen Now, nas linhas da Busca, no pill do mini player e nos controles do Now Playing; o container `player_controls` deixa de capturar as setas; o viewport do conteúdo ganha padding para o foco sair da lista em cima e embaixo.
- Foco D-pad no player: hook no `onStateChanged` do BottomSheet leva o foco ao play/pause quando o Now Playing expande e devolve ao mini player quando fecha.
- **Requisito de bundle**: TV box 32-bit só instala com os splits `armeabi-v7a`; monte o APK com base + `config.armeabi_v7a` (+ `config.xhdpi`) do APKM/XAPK oficial.
- **Limitação**: o indicador de foco é o highlight/ripple do framework, não escala o card; as abas do topo são alcançadas com UP + LEFT a partir do conteúdo.

Herdado da 1.2.0 (UI no API 29): o JS da Apple servido pelo APK reporta `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, deixando a página de login legível sobre o fundo preto do WebView; e o modo imersivo da tela de letras só é aplicado em API 30+, o que remove a faixa preta de 90 px no API 29.

Validado no TV box Xiaomi (API 34, 32-bit, 1920x1080/320 dpi): instala, abre, loga, toca, layout tablet; D-pad navega lista → pill → Now Playing → BACK; ENTER alterna PLAYING/PAUSED.

Entrada: **XAPK** do Apple Music 7.0.0 (APKPure). APKM não é aceito porque o bundle declara `apkFileType = XAPK`.

patches.name: Apple Music Android TV D-pad focus
patches.description: Adds a visible focus highlight to the Listen Now cards, the Search rows and the player, and reserves room for the mini player around the content viewport.

patches.name: Apple Music Android TV manifest
patches.description: Adds a leanback launcher entry point and banner to MainActivity and declares leanback/touchscreen as not required.

patches.name: Apple Music Android TV player expand focus
patches.description: Moves the D-pad focus into the Now Playing controls when the player sheet expands, because the sheet container itself is not focusable.

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink TLS trust
patches.description: Trusts the bundled Apple Root CA (res/raw/apple_ca) for gsd.apple.com only, inside the APK, so the Apple sign-in page loads on a head unit whose system CA store lacks that root. Nothing is installed on the device.

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink manifest
patches.description: Lowers minSdkVersion from 30 to 29 (Android 10) and removes the portrait lock of MLIChromeTabActivity.

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink support
patches.description: Unlocks landscape rotation, lowers the API floor to Android 10 (API 29), backports the API 30 java/androidx/accessibility calls and bypasses Play Integrity.

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink web assets
patches.description: Embeds Chrome 74-compatible copies of the Apple sign-in JavaScript assets so the sign-in page can run on the DiLink WebView, without a PC at runtime.

### APK para Android TV (32-bit)

O asset `AppleMusic-1.3.0-AndroidTV-arm32.apk` é o mesmo bundle já aplicado num merge 32-bit (base + `config.armeabi_v7a` + `config.xhdpi` do APKM oficial), assinado com `CN=Morphe`.

- SHA-256: `c4e1687845cee5952cc71aab9253c5d9744ade8be3031293c1d9f39e54a9f80c`
- Requer TV box com ABI `armeabi-v7a` (a maioria dos boxes Xiaomi e TVs 1080p); TVs arm64 usam o bundle completo via Morphe Manager.
- Instalação: `adb install -r AppleMusic-1.3.0-AndroidTV-arm32.apk` (desinstale o Apple Music oficial antes, se houver).
